description: Start counting an event as a conversion, such as 'subscription_started' or 'purchase'. Counts only events emitted after this call; it does not go back over earlier ones. Use the exact name the app already passes to emit_event. A name that is already a goal answers 409 conflict, and list_conversion_goals has its id.

event_name.description: Exact event name, as sent to emit_event

window_days.description: How many days after a click a conversion still counts for that email; defaults to 7

name: create_conversion_goal
